title: SK Capital Partners
description: skcapitalpartners.com Revenue $63 Million SK Capital Partners is a New York-based private equity firm founded in 2007 as a spinoff from Apax Partners, managing approximately 10 billion dollars across 60 plus investments in specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals and ingredients. Led by co-founder Barry Siadat, it targets control investments in companies with 100 million to 1 billion dollars in revenue and has built platforms like Advansix, Sartomer and Cura Particles through buy-and-build strategies. Its portfolio companies employ over 12,000 people and generate more than 5 billion dollars in annual revenue. Recent deals include the July 2026 acquisition of Lorama Group and the October 2026 purchase of Vesuvius Americas refractory assets. Key strengths are deep sector expertise in real-economy industrial businesses and proven IPO and trade sale exits.
